description: This PHP source file defines the vardefs (variable definitions) for the 'Alert' module in SuiteCRM, including the schema for the 'alerts' database table, field definitions, and relationships. It also ensures the VardefManager class is loaded and invokes it to create vardefs for the module.

classes.name: VardefManager
classes.description: A class responsible for managing vardef (variable definition) creation for modules in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: createVardef
methods.description: Static method of VardefManager used to create vardefs for a specified module with given features.
